source.title: Ten open problems connected with Hermitian and Kähler manifolds

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 3911230. Local workflow shard metadata identifies the exact work as Yum-Tong Siu, 'Ten open problems connected with Hermitian and Kähler manifolds', 1985, with DOI 10.1007/BFb0076160.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted / metadata_only. The DOI and Springer chapter routes point to the Springer chapter and book pages, but the available body is subscription-preview metadata and table-of-contents text rather than the two-page chapter body. The direct Springer PDF endpoint redirects through cookie/institutional access and did not yield a readable PDF in the local environment. Exact-title recovery found ResearchGate, Springer, library, ISBN, and bibliography/TOC records, but no candidate exposed the actual problem statements for the same work.

Stopped before candidate extraction because the source adequacy gate failed: only resolver metadata, table-of-contents entries, and bibliographic pages were available, and the workflow forbids extracting questions from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, or link labels when the technical source text is not visible.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/3911230.json and outputs/latest.json.
